newsitem.title: UK: Ex-Beatle Harrison has test for cancer - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Beatle Harrison has test for cancer - paper.

text.p: Former Beatle George Harrison is undergoing tests for cancer after discovering lumps in his throat, Britain's Sun newspaper said on Saturday.

The Sun said Harrison, 54, had a series of enlarged lymph nodes removed in an operation at a private hospital and is now waiting for the results of laboratory tests which will reveal whether they are cancerous.
It said Harrison gave up smoking in the early 1970s.
Although he is rarely seen in public now, Harrison has been involved in campaigns to raise money for cancer research.
